patch.value: Salvage sensitive legacy setting refusals and snapshot capture from the unmerged typed-binding review

Port four hardening behaviours left unmerged from the codex review work on the typed parameter binding item: diffPreset refuses sensitive legacy id_prefix generating public seed ids; diff --replace refuses sensitive legacy governance/validation/testing trees entering normalization history; diff and apply capture definition identity/settings/templates/seeds/flags/resolved values once before any await so mutating SDK getters cannot change compared state; the seed writer requires withSeeds ids to be registered catalog members. Each refusal is typed, leaves tracker bytes unchanged, and has a must-allow twin.

value.author: pi-presets-qz1k-salvage-1103
value.text: Salvage plan from the unmerged review work on the typed-binding item (leftover worktree diff, branch fix/typed-parameter-binding-review): (1) diffPreset refuses invalid_secret_reference when a sensitive legacy id_prefix would mint public seed ids; (2) diff --replace refuses invalid_secret_reference when sensitive legacy governance/validation/testing settings would enter isolated normalization history, and replacement normalization never copies a caller prefix into the scratch tracker; (3) diff and apply capture definition identity, settings, template documents, seed inventory, flags and resolved values once before any await, so mutating SDK accessors cannot change compared state (planner validates a record with undefined-sentinel semantics too); (4) the seed writer requires a withSeeds id to be a registered catalog member, refusing unknown and Object.prototype names before any write. Test-first: each behaviour gets a test that fails on current main, then the port. Each refusal is typed, leaves tracker bytes unchanged, and has a must-allow twin.

value.author: pi-presets-qz1k-salvage-1103
value.text: Gap proof on pristine main (new tests added first, src untouched): (a) 'plans and writers retain one snapshot' rejects artifact_unreadable because the planner consumes caller objects mutated across the replacement await; (b) 'replacement diff never materializes legacy sensitive SDK settings' expects invalid_secret_reference but main copies sensitive trees into the isolated normalization tracker and surfaces a raw scratch error (invalid_manifest); (c) the accessor property test dies with invalid_manifest because the template-completeness check re-reads definition.templateDocuments once per declared template; (d) the planner accepts record: null and a record without a preset id (missing expected rejection); (e) the seed writer accepts withSeeds with absent/unknown/Object.prototype preset ids and writes settings (missing expected rejection).

value.author: pi-presets-qz1k-salvage-1103
value.text: Port complete; all five gap tests now pass on the branch. Revert proofs (each guard reverted in isolation, the corresponding test failed at its intended adversarial assertion, source restored exactly): (1) dropping the sensitive id_prefix refusal -> 'Missing expected rejection' for invalid_secret_reference (the credential would mint public seed ids); (2) dropping the --replace refusal -> sensitive trees reach the isolated normalization tracker and a raw scratch error surfaces as invalid_manifest instead of the typed refusal; (3a) making planInput re-read definition getters -> accessor drift masked, inSync true !== false; (3b) feeding the caller's settings object back into replacement normalization -> artifact_unreadable, host refused the mutated governance; (3c) re-reading the preset identity in the writer -> identity read 3 !== 1 times; (3d) restoring truthiness record guards -> record: null and a record without a preset id accepted, missing rejection; (4) dropping the registered-identity refusal -> withSeeds selections with absent/unknown/prototype ids write settings, missing rejection. Focused regression pass on the touched areas (artifact-state, diff, params-review, params-boundaries, settings, shared, seed-normalization, seeds): 82/82 pass.
